senses.gloss: अभोक्तृ, ˚भोगिन् a. Not using or enjoying, abstemious.
अभोक्तृ, ˚भोगिन् a. Not using or enjoying, abstemious.

आभोगः [आ-भुज्-घञ्]
—1 Curving, winding.
—2 A curve; आभोगकुटिला (गङ्गा) Mb.; crumpling.
—3 Circuit, circumference, expanse, extension, precincts, environs; अकथितोऽपि
 ज्ञायत एव यथायमाभोगस्तपावेनस्येति Ś. 1; गगनाभोगः the expanse
 of heaven, wide firmament of the sky; Bh. 3. 57; Mv. 6. 30; शैलाभोगभुवो
 भवन्ति ककुभः Māl. 9. 16. प्रासादाभोगः the middle part of a palace;
 प्रासादाभोगविस्तीर्णः स्तुतिशब्दो ह्यवर्तत Rām. 2. 65. 3.
—4 Magnitude, fulness, extent, expansive form; गण्डाभोगात् Me. 93 from
 the broad cheek; प्रतिरवाभोग Māl. 3. 8, 4. 10, 5. 11; प्रतिभयाभोगैः
 प्लवङ्गाधिपैः Mv. 6. 24 bodily form or stature; U. 2. 14; भवाभोगोद्विग्नाः
 Bh. 3. 42, 86; Mv. 2; K. 305, 333.
—5 Effort.
—6 The expanded hood of a cobra (used by Varuṇa as his umbrella).
—7 Enjoyment, satiety, completion; विषयाभोगेषु नैवादरः Śāntilakṣaṇa.
—8 Serpent. आभोगं हन्मना हतम् Rv. 7. 94. 12.
अभोज् a. Ved. Not sacrificing; not giving food to the gods.

अभोजनम् Not eating, fasting, abstinence; त्रिरात्रं स्यादभोजनम्
 Ms. 11. 166, 203, 215.
अभोज्य a. Not to be eaten, prohibited as food, impure, unholy;

अभोज्य + .{@˚अन्न@} a. one whose food is prohibited from being eaten by
 others; य एतेऽन्ये त्वभोज्यान्नाः क्रमशः परिकीर्तिताः Ms. 4. 221.

आभोगय^1 a. [आभोगं याति या-क] To be enjoyed (as Soma juice); Rv. 1. 110. 2.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170209. note: alph. order; RV quote; AP and most others.

आभोगिः Ved.
—1 Enjoyment.
—2 Living, supporting life.
—3 Food, nourishment; Rv. 1. 113. 5.
